agent.none: No known agent found on this PC. Enter its command under “Other command…”.
agent.otherSub: any program that speaks ACP on stdin and stdout
agent.commandHint: One line, as in a terminal. A word with spaces goes in double quotes.
agent.permissions: When the agent asks for permission
agent.permNote: Applies to every agent. A test never asks in game: it denies every request.
agent.cwdHint: Where the agent works. Empty: Familiar's own folder.
agent.testing: Asking the agent… This can take a minute; you can leave this page.
agent.notStarted: This agent is saved, but Familiar did not start with it.
agent.err.quote: A double quote is not closed.
agent.err.hostSpaces: A computer name has no spaces.
agent.err.hostDash: A computer name cannot start with “-”.
agent.err.userSpaces: A user name has no spaces.
agent.err.cwdRequired: Enter the working folder on the other computer.
agent.ssh.computerHint: A name, an address or a Host from your .ssh/config.
agent.ssh.advancedHint: Only to override what .ssh/config says. Empty fields keep it.
agent.ssh.hint.key: your key must be in the .ssh folder of your user folder on this PC, and its public half in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the other computer. Without a key, choose Password: Familiar keeps it in the system keychain. Settings in .ssh/config, such as another port or a jump host, are used too.
agent.ssh.hint.passphrase: your key must be in the .ssh folder of your user folder on this PC, and its public half in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the other computer. Familiar keeps the passphrase in the system keychain and gives it only to ssh, and only for that key.
agent.ssh.hint.password: the other computer must allow signing in with a password. Familiar keeps it in the system keychain and gives it only to ssh, and only for this computer. A key in the .ssh folder of your user folder is safer.
agent.ssh.viaJump: Your .ssh/config connects to {host} through {via}. Familiar does not use a saved password or passphrase there; use a key without a passphrase or your SSH agent.
agent.ssh.secretNote: Enter it once. It goes into the system keychain, never into a file.
agent.ssh.secretStored: One is stored in the system keychain for this computer. Enter a new one to replace it.
agent.ssh.commandHint: Such as hermes acp, or with the program's full path.
agent.ssh.cwdHint: Required: a folder on the other computer, starting with /, such as /home/you. The other computer needs a POSIX shell (Linux, macOS or WSL).
agent.ssh.connected: Signed in, and the agent's program is there.
agent.ssh.connectedAt: Signed in, and the agent's program is there: {path}
agent.ssh.pathHint: The agent starts without your login profile and may not find the program by its name alone. With the full path it does.
agent.ssh.testAfter: The connection works. “Test the agent” now asks the agent itself.
agent.ssh.trustFirst: First connection to {host}. Its key's fingerprint:
agent.ssh.trustCompare: Compare it with what the computer itself shows before you trust it, for example with this command there:
agent.ssh.unreachable: Familiar could not reach {host} directly to read its key, for example because it is only reachable through a jump host, or it is offline. Connect once with ssh {host} in a terminal and confirm its key there, then try again.
